Hola, I'm Corey

Staff Product Designer and Systems Designer with over 12 years experience in UX & interface design, prototyping, and user research.

Currently at CNN, working to enhance and scale our Design System. Laser-focused on launching an end-to-end Figma to code pipeline, empowering designers to publish and maintain accessible design systems at scale.

Prior to design systems, I led product design initiatives for a range of products in video, community, e-commerce and a variety of funded 0:1 products. I thrive in ambiguity, and love sinking my teeth into a rich problem space that puts me out of my comfort zone.
